# Edwin Trigos | Tech Lead & .NET Developer

> Portfolio of Edwin Trigos — Tech Lead and .NET Developer who leads development of the credit area at a Colombian consumer-credit fintech (loan origination, credit-limit and credit-risk calculation, identity verification, credit bureaus). Open to remote roles, UTC−5, English B1. Downloadable CV: https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/cv/Edwin-Trigos-CV-EN.pdf. 5+ years building production systems including a 114-endpoint LOS API, identity validation orchestrator, centralized communications platform, and a B2B SaaS risk management platform. Bilingual technical blog (ES/EN) covering architecture decisions, design patterns, and real production tradeoffs. Based in Bucaramanga, Colombia.

Technologies: .NET 8+, C#, SQL Server, Dapper, Clean Architecture, React 19, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel, AWS, Flutter, Docker, LLM tool calling, SSE, Cloudflare Workers, IndexedDB, Playwright, Vitest.

## Case Studies — Production Systems
- [LOS — Loan Origination System](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Test suite grown from 8 test files to 3,009 passing tests in ~10 weeks; a second sales channel (web self-service) shipped with 0 regressions in the in-store channel. 114+ API endpoints, 27 stored procedures, 23-state lifecycle, biometric verification, INSERT-ONLY audit. Built from scratch with Clean Architecture. Later: configurable risk-data provider behind a kill switch, operator case workspace redesigned in chained commits, and an administrative endpoint whose permission is proven through the real HTTP pipeline.
- [DevManager — Multi-tenant SaaS with an AI Agent](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Degree project grown into an independent product. .NET 8 + React; permission-filtered LLM tool calling, typed SSE event stream, per-organization token quota, human-in-the-loop confirmation as one conditional transaction (double approve returns 409). 852 API tests + 52 Playwright e2e tests.
- [STARSOL SaaS Platform](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): B2B SaaS for financial risk management (SARLAFT, SARC, SIAR). Async architecture with 3 background workers, .NET MAUI client, AWS infrastructure. N+1 fix that ended 7-hour timeouts in the nightly regulatory calculation; phased Laravel 8→13 upgrade against a 1,143-test baseline (in progress).
- [SOVI — Identity Validation Orchestrator](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Strategy pattern with voice bot + manual fallback. Catalog-driven decision engine. Full biometric audit trail.
- [Datacredito API Integration](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Credit bureau API with Polly circuit breaker + retry. Query times reduced from 3s to 400ms. JWT auth + Serilog structured logging.
- [Payroll System — ERP Document Generation for Franchise Chain](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Extended CRM routing with 3 new payroll types on top of 45+ existing ones. 21 Crystal Reports templates. Non-invasive extension — zero breaks in legacy payroll types.
- [Admin Module UI Architecture](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Separated monitoring dashboard from CRUD configuration. Navigation reflects Clean Architecture backend domains.
- [Portfolio — Hybrid Architecture](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Curated content layer + GitHub API widget, native i18n, an XP-style desktop theme built with strict TDD against a committed Playwright driver (98/98 checks), a pixel-diff gate for the newspaper theme, and JSON-LD + llms.txt that took a GEO audit from 58 to 83/100.
- [Centralized Email Communications API](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): 5 email silos unified into one Clean Architecture API with a provider-agnostic interface, 8 multi-tenant accounts, GUID traceability per transaction. Diagnosis time from 30 minutes to 5 seconds.
- [Harmony-Music — Open Source Flutter Music App](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Took an unmaintained fork from "does not compile" to release v1.12.2 in ~36 commits: modern Gradle/AGP/Kotlin toolchain, InnerTube search bucketing rewrite, audio on 3 platforms with one Dart API.
- [ReaderSS — RSS Reader with Offline Reading](https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects): Ports-and-adapters client on IndexedDB, Cloudflare Workers relay with SSRF guard, 4 feed parsers, 426 tests at ~95% coverage, 88 kB gzipped bundle.
